description: Return the account owner's Studio credit balance; reading it spends nothing. Check it before generate_custom_print so you can tell the human the cost (1 credit per generation with either engine; preserve=true is free) and what will be left. No Studio account yet → balance 0 and studio_account=false; the first generation creates the account with 20 welcome credits. Every bought tee adds 20 credits, and more can be bought at allover.art/studio.
name: get_studio_credits

studio_account.description: False if the user has no Studio account yet (first generate auto-creates one).

title: Check Studio credits
